question: ______ species are those species of plants and animals which are found exclusively in a particular area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Endemic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• **Endemic species** are unique to a particular area and are not found anywhere else in the world.
 
• These species are important because they often play a critical role in the ecosystem of their native habitat.
